name: Regular Expressions Basics
equipment: A computer with Python 3 installed (or an online REPL like replit.com)
instructions: This lesson covers regular expressions basics.
The re module matches patterns in text, like finding all email addresses in a string.
matches = re.findall(r'\d+', 'I have 3 cats and 2 dogs')
Type the example into a real Python file (or REPL), run it, then modify it until you understand why it behaves that way.
